results.description: DoD Check 1: Generic person icon (👤) replaced with attendance indicators
DoD Check 2: short_name: null / attendance_status_color: null maps to ✅ Present
DoD Check 3: short_name: "AB" / attendance_status_color: "red" maps to ❌ Absent
DoD Check 4: Unrecorded or missing attendance records map to ❓ Unchecked
DoD Check 5: Future lessons (startTime > now) skip Schoolmate calls and render neutral
DoD Check 6: Per-student attendance records are NOT stored in persistent EE-CRM DB (proxy-only with TTL cache)
DoD Check 7: Attendance indicators render on both Teacher Schedule and Day Details pages
API Route validates required parameters (returns HTTP 400)
